does: Builds the loading screen's view model: registers it as a client game-state listener, the properties LoadingState, LevelName and VisibileHintIndex (-1 at first), the hint collection, the AdvanceHintCommand bound to code:gui::DCLoadingScreen::OnAdvanceHintCommand, a rand() seed and the ecl::HintManager pointer.

evidence.says: dx11 pseudo-code: the only user of the text VisibileHintIndex; it adds itself to ecl__gGameStateEventManager+8, stores ecl::HintManager::m_ptr at +0x370 and rand() at +0x360 and +0x364

the fork reads the live view model at every hint drawn (HintShown rows, copy attacks, first starts): its +0x370 is the ecl::HintManager this constructor stores (the count read through it is the list's, 49), and the index drawn from the rand() state it seeds at +0x364 is within the list
